headline: Exploited VMware vCenter and Cisco Expressway flaws reach their CISA deadline today
plain_summary: Google says a suspected state-backed group has exploited a flaw in VMware vCenter since September, and a Cisco Expressway flaw was exploited after public proof-of-concept code appeared. CISA's patch deadline for both is 23 November. KEPCO confirmed that personal data of over 1.5 million people leaked, and a Guadeloupe hospital is cancelling care after a cyberattack. Organisations running these products should patch now.

items.title: VMware vCenter zero-day CVE-2026-123890 exploited by suspected state actor
items.why: Google says ARMORY CASTLE has exploited this authentication bypass since early September; CISA's deadline is 23 November.
items.action: Google advises applying Broadcom's patches immediately; fixed builds are 8.0 U3m, 9.0.2.0200 and 9.1.1.0200, and 7.0 has no public patch. Restrict inbound access to and egress from vCenter.

items.title: Cisco Expressway flaw CVE-2026-76466 exploited after public PoC
items.why: F6 investigated an attack that spread across clustered Expressway nodes; Cisco's advisory still says it knows of no malicious use.
items.action: If you run clustered Expressway, upgrade to X15.5.20 now; Cisco says there is no workaround. If you cannot patch at once, F6 advises blocking TCP 4371-4372 except from trusted cluster node IPs.

items.title: CISA adds SAP NetWeaver flaw CVE-2025-42884 to known-exploited list
items.why: CISA lists it based on evidence of active exploitation; SAP fixed it in November 2025 and the deadline is 23 November.
items.action: General advice: confirm SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal has the fix SAP released in its November 2025 Patchday.

items.title: F5 BIG-IP flaw CVE-2026-126714 has public proof-of-concept code
items.why: HKCERT rates it high risk and says a remote authenticated attacker could run system commands; no exploitation is stated in the event.
items.action: HKCERT advises applying the workarounds issued by F5 in advisory K000164320 for BIG-IP 17.1.0 - 17.1.3, 17.5.0 - 17.5.1 and 21.1.0.

items.title: Ghostscript sandbox escape CVE-2026-125396 reachable through file uploads
items.why: pwn.ai showed it in about ten common applications; ThaiCERT says a proof of concept is public and reports no confirmed real-world exploitation.
items.action: Update Ghostscript to 10.08.0, and check for separately bundled Ghostscript copies in containers or applications.

items.title: KEPCO says data of over 1.5 million people leaked
items.why: KEPCO confirmed the leak from Hanjeon ON and its SRM system; exposed data includes resident registration, bank account and card numbers.
items.action: KEPCO urges caution with calls, texts and emails that impersonate KEPCO, and runs a service where customers can check whether their data leaked.

items.title: CHU de Guadeloupe hospital hit by cyberattack, care postponed
items.why: Telephone, imaging and software are down and part of the databases was reportedly encrypted; urgent care continues.
items.action: As La 1ère relays, the SAMU head advises calling the emergency medical line before going to the hospital.

items.title: Chainflip says attacker drained its vaults and offers a bounty
items.why: Chainflip Labs says funds were taken on 21 November and it has identified the mechanism of key exposure; the protocol is reportedly in safe mode.
